title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Kyklaminos hollow-root oil preparation has a wax-conditioned salve branch
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Dioscorides Wellmann II.164 §4 preserves a concrete staged content model: the same named root is hollowed and filled with oil, placed on hot ashes, and only sometimes receives a little Tyrrhenian wax so it becomes viscous, with a salve for chilblains named as the use. The next clauses separately say the cut root is stored like squill and report burning and reshaping it into pastilles for philtres; do not collapse these into mandatory steps on one batch or erase the report status. A future whole-unit candidate must encode the intermediate state and optional wax relation while accounting for all three dispositions. No target form is assigned in this raw proposal. Source scope is the complete retained critical-edition entry, not a full medieval witness: Morgan M.652 f72v contains only the opening description, and the continuation was not acquired. This is not evidence of treatment efficacy, modern botanical identity, or Voynich transmission. Related processing hypotheses exist (including IDEA000679 and the recent IDEA000794 dose/preparation idea); lexical search is navigation, and this card makes no novelty claim.

design.mechanism: A single named plant root is transformed through an oil-filled hollow-root heating stage; optional wax conditions a viscous topical output, while storage and reported burning/pastille preparation remain separately scoped dispositions.
design.unit: Complete f85r2 W18–23 whole block as named in the live route; no candidate forms or target content were inspected or assigned.
design.contrast: Wax is optional and belongs inside the heated oil preparation, conditioning a viscous salve for chilblains; rival flattening treats wax, storage, burning, and pastille formation as mandatory consecutive steps on one batch or drops the source's reported-status marker.
design.prediction: If this source model is ever tested, a complete fixed target reading must preserve root continuity through hollowing, oil filling, and heating; distinguish wax-conditioned viscosity and salve use from cut-root storage; and retain the reported burning-to-pastille/philtres clause without merging all outputs into one obligatory chain.
design.scope: Exploratory source-content hypothesis only; target meaning unbound, no target forms assigned, not a selected experiment.

source_evidence.quote: 4 ἐγκοιλανθεῖσα δὲ πληροῦται τοῦ ἐλαίου καὶ τίθεται ἐπὶ θερμοσποδιᾶς, προσεμβάλλεται δὲ ἐνίοτε καὶ κηροῦ Τυρρηνικοῦ ὀλίγον, ὡς γλοιῶδες γενέσθαι, κατάχρισμα ἄριστον χιμετλιῶσιν. ἀποτίθεται δὲ ἡ ῥίζα τμηθεῖσα ὥσπερ σκίλλα. ἱστορεῖται δὲ καὶ πρὸς φίλτρα αὐτὴν λαμβάνεσθαι καεῖσαν ἀναπλασθεἰσάν τε εἰς τροχίσκους, φύεται δὲ ἐν συσκίοις τόποις, μάλιστα δὲ ὑπὸ τὰ δένδρα.
